title: Paul McCartney – songs, albums, biography, photos and more!
content:
Beatle people » Paul McCartney
There were four people in The Beatles, and I was one of them. There were two people in the Lennon-McCartney songwriting team, and I was one of them. I mean, right there, that’s enough for anyone’s life. And there was one guy who wrote ‘Yesterday’, and I was him. One guy who wrote ‘Let It Be’, ‘Fool On The Hill’, ‘Lady Madonna’ – and I was him, too. All of these things would be enough for anyone’s life. So to be involved in all of them is pretty surprising. And you have to pinch yourself.
Paul McCartney
